title: Environmental Horticulture and Design
author: Dayone Koo
_comment: PROGRAM EVALUATION (evaluate-program skill). Subject is the PROGRAM (Foothill College x TOP 010900), not a job title. Destination SOCs DERIVED: crosswalk(010900) intersected with SECTORS['agwet'].socs minus ALL_OTHER/PROMOTION/EXPERIENCE_5YR = ['37-3012', '37-1012']. lede: This evaluation assembles labor-market supply and demand evidence for Foothill College's Environmental Horticulture and Design program (TOP 010900). It covers regional occupational demand targeted by the program, and the program's award and enrollment trends in the context of other colleges offering the same program in the region.
demand_note: Foothill's Environmental Horticulture and Design program leads to SOC 37-1012 and SOC 37-3012 via the TOP–CIP–SOC crosswalk. [According to the Centers of Excellence](https://datastudio.google.com/u/0/reporting/5060057c-b9ba-4081-9ed7-83356eaa7061), these occupations demand roughly 580 openings a year.
alignment_note: The set of colleges offering TOP 010900 in the Bay Area. All of these colleges support SOC 37-1012 and 37-3012 via the same TOP code through the TOP–CIP–SOC crosswalk.
award_note: Award trends for each member-college program. Empty cells indicate no data reported via DataMart.
enrollment_note: Enrollment trends for each member-college program. Empty cells indicate no data reported via DataMart.

37-3012.description: Mixes and applies pesticides, herbicides, and fungicides to trees, shrubs, lawns, and crops — work that requires specific training and state certification.

37-1012.description: Directs and coordinates landscaping and groundskeeping crews — reviewing contracts to determine service, machine, and workforce requirements.
